key: PWM Timing and Waveform Generator (Five-phase, Two-level)
title: PWM Timing and Waveform Generator (Five-phase, Two-level)
text: Generate five-phase, two-level gating time information, 2 inputs, 3 outputs, {Sampling mode} sets Wave-sampling method; {Continuous PWM} sets the continuous pulse width modulation method SPWM: sinusoidal and {Switching frequency (Hz)} sets the switching rate 1e3. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Continuous PWM
params.values: Continuous pulse width modulation method SPWM: sinusoidal PWM (default) | SVM: space vector modulation
